key_holding: Section 425.16 does NOT apply to (b) actions brought solely in the public interest meeting three conditions (no personal relief, important public right, disproportionate burden) or (c) commercial speech by sellers of goods/services. But these exemptions do NOT apply to journalists, media, or artistic works under (d). This section prevents weaponization of anti-SLAPP against legitimate public interest litigation while preserving anti-SLAPP protection for speech and media defendants.

amendment_history.event: Stats. 2003, Ch. 338, Sec. 2. Added to prevent abuse of §425.16 against legitimate public interest and consumer protection actions.
